description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractRestParser in the AWS SDK for PHP, which handles parsing REST API responses, including extracting payloads, headers, and status codes, and converting them into AWS Result objects.

classes.name: AbstractRestParser
classes.description: An abstract class for parsing REST API responses in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods for extracting payloads, headers, status codes, and converting responses into Result objects.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Abstract method to parse payload from a response; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the parsing of the response based on the operation output, extracting payload, headers, status, and returning a Result object.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts and processes the payload from the response, handling event streams, structures, and streaming data.

methods.name: extractHeader
methods.description: Extracts a single header value from the response and converts it based on type (float, int, boolean, blob, timestamp, string).

methods.name: extractHeaders
methods.description: Extracts multiple headers with an optional prefix, organizing them into an associative array.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the status code from the response and adds it to the result.
